pane.title: Interactive rebase
title: Rebase
empty: Open this from the Git log (Interactive rebase from here) or the Git sidebar.
base.placeholder: Rebase onto: a commit or branch, e.g. HEAD~5 or main
noBase: Enter the commit or branch to rebase onto. The commits after it, up to HEAD, are listed here to reorder, reword, squash or drop.
order: Oldest first, applied top to bottom
keys: ↑/↓ select · Alt+↑/↓ move · p r e s f d set the action
action.squash: squash: meld into the previous commit, edit the message
action.fixup: fixup: meld into the previous commit, drop this message
updateRefs: Also update the branches pointing into these commits
warn.merges: There are merge commits in this range. An interactive rebase flattens them: the merges are not kept.
err.first: {hash} is the first commit: it can't be squashed or fixed up into nothing.
stopped.conflicts: The rebase stopped: {count} files have conflicts. Resolve them, then continue.
stopped.edit: The rebase stopped for an edit. Amend the commit, then continue.
mem.button: Reword without touching the work tree
mem.tip: Rewrites the commit messages you changed in the repository only: files and staged changes stay as they are.
mem.done: Reworded {count} commits without touching the work tree.
op.ready: No conflicts left: continue the operation.
op.abort.ask: Abort the operation? What you resolved so far is lost.
